title: Bloomkeeper is now BloomGauge, and it keeps itself up to date

highlights.title: Bloomkeeper is now BloomGauge
highlights.detail: Same app, same data, same settings, with a new name. The website moves to bloomgauge.io, and old links keep working.

highlights.title: BloomGauge now updates itself
highlights.detail: New versions download in the background and install while you're away from the Mac. They never install during a model switch, warm-up or trial. BloomGauge reopens the way it was and keeps its home model, and Darkbloom keeps serving throughout. To turn this off, clear Update BloomGauge automatically in More → Help & feedback. If you had turned automatic update checks off before, they stay off.

highlights.title: Fewer hours earning nothing
highlights.detail: After Darkbloom unloads an idle model, BloomGauge reloads it right away. Before, it could wait 20+ minutes thinking a model was loading, or say there wasn't enough free memory. With cache cleanup allowed, it clears the macOS file cache and reloads every time. Turning the manager on also works on battery power now.

highlights.title: Ready for macOS 27 and App Attest
highlights.detail: Macs that Darkbloom verifies through App Attest without its MDM now get everything the others do. BloomGauge brings the previous model back after a failed switch, runtime-gated models like Qwen3.8 can be used, and Macs like yours stall detection works. The Reputation card shows the Mac's trust tier.

highlights.title: Pair fallback
highlights.detail: If you chose two models and Darkbloom can't fit both in memory right now, BloomGauge serves one of them instead of waiting, and says so. It goes back to the pair once there is enough free memory.

highlights.title: A simpler Pulse
highlights.detail: One earnings graph with 1 h, 3 h, 6 h, 12 h, 24 h, 3 d and 7 d views shows what you earned in that time, base rewards included. A Today tile shows the end-of-day estimate.

highlights.title: Alerts and notification settings
highlights.detail: Choose which alerts go to this Mac and to your phone in Optimizer → Overview → Notifications. New: regular Mac notifications, an alert when earnings stay high, and alerts when the manager considers or makes a switch. Quiet hours hold everything except problems. Phone notifications now show amounts (encrypted on the way); you can turn amounts off.

highlights.title: Clearer statuses and problem reports
highlights.detail: Statistics wait until the Darkbloom network has cleared the Mac after a restart, and a switch the network didn't accept says why. Reading Darkbloom's settings no longer fails mid-rewrite, the model controls name launch settings Darkbloom dropped, and problem reports say whether the Manager or the older optimizer was on.
